notes.content:

The release date for HEART of CROWN Online on Steam (full version) and Nintendo Switch has been set for December 18, 2025!
Pre-orders are now open as well.
For more details, please visit the official page of our publisher, PLAYISM.
https://playism.com/game/heart-of-crown/

https://playism.com/news/2025/0916/tgs2025/

In addition, the emote featured on this pin badge will also be implemented in-game with the shop update on September 29!!

[previewyoutube=ngJEW--rjIA;full][/previewyoutube]
Come and see the Princesses in their even more captivating forms!
Please note that character voices will be implemented with the transition to the full version.

As mentioned in our recent news, we are currently considering whether it will be possible to implement the cards under adjustment in Room Match only.
We will announce further details once they are finalized, so please stay tuned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851102/0ca095deb0cd8d404af2e304f885461264089f88.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
Greetings to all the influential figures of the empire!

Starting from 10:00 AM (JST) on July 11th, we will be updating the supply and ROM. 

[h2]"Northern Enchantress" Second Edition – Beta Phase 5 Card Details[/h2]
The fifth batch of cards from Northern Enchantress: Second Edition is scheduled to be added in the July 11 update.
For one week only, from the end of the July 11 update until just before the July 18 update, supply sets will feature a mix of the currently available fourth batch and the new fifth batch cards. Don’t miss out!
*Starting with the July 18 update, only the two cards from the fifth batch will appear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851102/8bf1fb934fcf1b6f4376b4903151b39781be10c8.png[/img]
Here are the two cards featured in the fifth wave of the Northern Enchantress: Second Edition beta release.

[h3]Bishop[/h3]
This is a brand-new card introduced in Northern Enchantress: Second Edition.
Until now, most Action/Succession cards costing 6 coins or more have focused on generating coin value. However, Bishop breaks that mold by combining the functionality of Fountain of Wishes into its effect.
In late-game scenarios where players are racing to reveal Succession cards, having this card in your deck can make a significant difference in the outcome.

[h3]City Development[/h3]
This is another brand-new card introduced in Northern Enchantress: Second Edition.
It provides 2 coins and 1 link, and features a unique ability: by banishing a card from your hand, you can gain a Farming Village from the Market.
Additionally, after you establish a Princess, if there's a Farming Village in your domain, you may banish that Farming Village to set this card in its place instead.
With its flexible and powerful mechanics, this card shines particularly in the early to mid-game.

Greetings to all the influential figures of the empire!

[h1]"Northern Enchantress" Second Edition – Beta Phase 3 Card Details[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851102/e8dd93a496c039e9e20b480e64796dde5bd6d964.png[/img]
Here are the four cards featured in the third wave of the "Northern Enchantress" Second Edition beta implementation:

"Lucky Piece" and "Baptism" are returning cards from the original Northern Enchantress, but Baptism in particular has undergone significant adjustments.

While its cost remains unchanged, Baptism now offers a choice of effect upon banishing a card—you can now choose to draw 1 card. In addition, the banishable card can now be selected from either your hand or discard pile, making it seem like a major buff at first glance.

However, the updated Baptism no longer has a link icon, meaning you'll need to combine it with a 2-link card to take full advantage of the draw effect—making smart pairing and strategic use more important than ever.

As brand-new additions to the Northern Enchantress Second Edition, "Stone Circle" and "Divination Card" will also debut in this wave.

[h2]・Stone Circle[/h2]
These cards introduce a brand-new type of effect never seen before in HEART of CROWN.

While they may require a bit of setup, they can be quite powerful if you meet their conditions early in the game. Additionally, they provide new ways for various cards to gain succession points through their effects, greatly expanding strategic options and making for a fun and rewarding gameplay experience.

We hope you’ll try them out extensively and share your thoughts and feedback with us!
[h3]・Stone Circle FAQ[/h3]
Q.If you have set more than one "Stone Circle" in your domain and exile a card, will the effect of all "Stone Circle" cards be triggered?
A.Yes, they will be triggered.

Q.If I exile a copy of "Tally" from my hand using its own effect, but place it in the discard pile instead of the exile zone, or if I set an inheritance card that was exiled by "Ethereal Deal: Senco," will the effect of "Stone Circle" be triggered?
A.In both cases, the effect of "Stone Circle" will be triggered.

[h2]・Divination Card[/h2]
A new 2-cost card with 2 links is making its debut.
Its effect is straightforward and easy to use, making it a versatile addition to many decks.
However, unlike most existing 2-link cards, it does not have a "draw 1 card" effect.
As a result, players used to the traditional feel of 2-link cards may find it slightly disorienting at first—so keep that in mind!

notes.title: 『HEART of CROWN Online』Major Update Announcement & New Card Introduction
notes.content:
Greetings to all the influential figures of the empire!

[h2]The first major update is finally being implemented.[/h2]
Server maintenance for the major update will be conducted starting at [h3]2:00 PM (JST) on September 6th.[/h3]

[h2]Introduction of a New Princess[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851102/2bc6526d35515e847aa8d281e8c48e99d61a4878.png[/img]

Introducing the new princess 'Far East Princess of Sums, Ohka' from 'Far East Territory,' which is finally being implemented.

The ability from the original version, 'Banish two cards to gain a new card,' remains intact but has evolved to become even more user-friendly and powerful. 
Now, not only can you target cards from your hand, but you can also include cards played that turn in the ability, eliminating any loss of tempo. 
Although the gained card goes to the top of your deck instead of your hand, which might seem like a nerf at first, it allows you to use the acquired card with the ability again on the next turn, making deck compression easier to achieve every turn.

While it's no longer possible to gain an 'Imperial Crown' with her ability, her potential more than makes up for it. 
The more times you can use her ability, the better, making her synergize well with rapid coronations. 
However, be cautious in situations where attack cards that force discarding are common or where the supply lacks specific-cost cards, as you might not be able to use her ability as effectively as expected.

[h2]Introducing new cards[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851102/9be084d8e0ad92e05b9f75941ab7f42e6b9473ac.png[/img]

The fifth set of additional cards from 'Far East Territory' will be 'Collector's Items' and 'Tally.

[h3]『Collector's Items』[/h3]
These are new cards from the second edition of 'Far East Territory.'
With a cost of 3 and the ability to generate 2 coins, they are effective in the early game. 
Additionally, when banished, they can be treated as any cost from 1 to 5 and allow you to gain a card of equal cost to their own. 
Exchanging them for powerful 4-5 cost cards or for 'Senator' later in the game is a good option, but the best synergy, without a doubt, is with 'Ohka's' ability.

[h3]『Tally』[/h3]
Although these cards existed in the original version, their effects have significantly changed.
Now, they are linked cards, and while it costs 1 coin to banish a card, you can now choose to banish from either your hand or discard pile. Additionally, when you banish a card, you get to draw 1, making them more versatile and easier to use.
Furthermore, the ability to banish 'Tally' from your hand and place it in the discard pile instead of the foreign area synergizes well with 'Adventurer' and 'Ohka's' abilities, allowing you to repeatedly gain powerful cards.

notes.title: 『HEART of CROWN Online』Ver1.0.2 patch note &New Card Introduction
notes.content:
[h3]Revision Details[/h3]
・We have added the display of the client version. The latest version is 1.0.2.
・We have fixed display issues with the font.
・We have added new cards.
・We have set time limits in Quick Match. A stricter time control will be implemented in the upcoming Rank Match.
・We have implemented disconnection processes for players who have not performed any actions for a certain period.
・After entering sudden death, you can now select "Return To Title" from the "MENU" in the top right corner.
・It is now possible to play in Room Match (Create Room) with CPU opponents.
・We have added some animations.
・We have fixed other bugs.
・We have improved the player UI in the top right corner, arranging the order not by play sequence but by seating. The top player is on the left, the second is across, and the third is on the right.
・We have made TIPS easier to understand.
・We have improved the UI and controls.

[h3]New Card Introduction[/h3]

Additionally, with today's update, new cards will be added to the supply. This will include some cards that are appearing for the first time in "HEART of CROWN Online," so let me briefly introduce them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851102/2fcde26c69d33908eda1ba627294ed4660c1806d.png[/img]

[h3]『Roused Monster』[/h3]
When this card is included in the supply, it becomes difficult to just keep buying powerful high-cost cards casually. 
Cards like "Refuge" or "Magic Talisman" will prove to be useful. 
Building a low-cost deck as a strategy to evade the gaze of the monster is another viable approach.

[h3]『Library』[/h3]
The abilities have been significantly changed from the first edition. 
As you play more Action cards, you earn more coins, making it highly compatible with low-cost cards and draw cards. 
By building a deck that utilizes the library, not only does "Duke" become more accessible, but also rare cards like "Imperial Capital" and "Imperial Crown" become easier to obtain.

[h3]『Imperial Estate』[/h3]
Like "Library," the abilities of this card have also been changed since the first edition. Since this card itself generates two coins, purchasing it early in the game won't be a hindrance, and if played after establishing a princess, it automatically sets itself in the Domain during the cleanup phase. 
This makes it a valuable card that allows you to continue strengthening your deck while also earning inheritance points.

Furthermore, as it is a "TERRITORY" card, once set in the Domain, it allows you to keep any Action card up to a cost of five. This feature adds to its appeal.

[h3]『Cultivation Order』[/h3]
This card was newly added in the second edition.
Like the "Infantry Battalion," it costs 4 and yields 2 coins, but unlike "Infantry Battalion," which impacts the turn it's played, the effects of Cultivation Order start from the next turn. 
If used frequently, the number of cards in your deck can increase significantly, so you may need to actively use it if you have cards that can exile unnecessary cards like "Contribution" or "Adventurer," or if there are cards that can be enhanced.

notes.title: Early Access Release of 'HEART of CROWN Online' Begins!
notes.content:
[h1]The race to place your favored princess on the throne begins.[/h1]

Greetings to all the influential figures of the empire!

Thank you for your patience.
The early access version of "HEART of CROWN Online" is now available for sale!

In addition to the "Room Match" released in the March demo version, the "Quick Match," which allows you to easily play against anyone, is finally being unlocked. The number of supplies has also significantly increased, making HEART of CROWN even more enjoyable. Please look forward to it!

[previewyoutube=t4FVY57HFCw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Early Access Roadmap[/h1]
From the start of early access sales, we aim to release the official version within approximately one year! We plan to incorporate many more contents, so please take a look at the roadmap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851102/e22e76ce585628880035a706dab07c717df2dfbc.png[/img]

As our first milestone, we plan to enhance the presentation by June 2024, starting with adding effects and animations for the princesses. 
For CPU battles, we will add even more challenging difficulty levels, and implement a feature that allows you to choose and play with your favorite supplies from those available. Regarding the expansion of music and sound effects, this will include the background music for each princess that was popular in the previous game.

In Q3 2024, we will perform our first major update. The highlight of this update is the implementation of ranked matches, where you can earn titles by defeating rivals, similar to the previous game. The highest title you can achieve is "Archduke."
Additionally, "HEART of CROWN Online" will adopt a seasonal system where scores are reset every 2 to 3 months. 
In line with this, we will implement daily quests that allow players to earn in-game currency and items by completing specific tasks each day.

In the second major update in Q4 2024, we will introduce a new single-player mode that is different from the CPU battles. Accompanying this, we will also implement voices for key characters, starting with the princesses!
In the shop, you will be able to use in-game currency and items to purchase titles and emotes. These can be used to customize your profile, which will be reflected in your matches.
I won't say much now about the accession-only graphics... stay tuned!

※Minor UI updates and additional cards will be implemented and updated as needed, so they are not included in the roadmap. More details will be added when we publish a more detailed roadmap in the future.

We aim to make "HEART of CROWN Online" even better by incorporating your feedback. Please feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/4Gx3SF9]official Discord[/url] and share your opinions and thoughts. We also plan to provide a dedicated Discord for matches and tournaments.
